name: 유스티나
motion_summary: Eternal Return Justyna Astra Burst: red high ponytail, silver/black futuristic armour, bright alert eyes, goggles resting on head, her futuristic energy gun per reference. R is an aerial maximum-firepower barrage. Frames: ready; knees bend; gun charging; spring upward; airborne with legs tucked and gun pointed diagonally down-right; first blue-white artillery pulse; second pulse with recoil; third rapid pulse with torso tilt; largest final blue/cyan energy burst below-right; descend; land knees bent; ready. Airborne frames 4 through 10 inclusive in one-based counting. Do not replace her weapon with Nia's controller. No face-obscuring beam. Leave at least 12 percent of each cell as transparent margin.
visual_review: 빨간 포니테일·밝은 파란 눈·에너지 화기가 식별되며 도약, 공중 포격, 반동, 착지가 보입니다. 12셀과 투명 배경을 확인했습니다.
